125 civilians are killed nationwide by the Syrian army, included 64 people reportedly summarily executed after being caught trying to flee the city of Homs.
At least 115 people are killed in a government offensive against Al-Qaeda linked militants in Somalia.
M 7.4 - 124 km W of Lebu, Chile
Chile: An 8.8 magnitude earthquake (the fifth largest on record at the time) and tsunami strikes central Chile, affecting 80% of the population and leaving 525 people dead.

Philippines: A bomb planted by Abu Sayyaf cayses a fire on the passenger ferry SuperFerry 14 off El Fraile island, shortly after leaving Manila harbor, killing at least 116 people. It is considered as the country's worst terrorist attack.
